name: Innovators Façade Systems Limited
about: Innovators Façade Systems Limited engages in the designing, engineering, fabrication, supply, and installation of facade systems in India. The company offers unitized structural glazing, curtail walls, frameless glass, windows and doors, railing, louvres, canopies, sky lights, dry stone cladding, ACP, HPL, and sheet cladding products; and modular partitions, cleanroom equipment, containment solutions, and pharmaceutics process equipment, as well as metal doors, such as fire-rated, clean room, and industrial doors. It primarily serves architects, general contractors, and developers. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Thane, India.
